id: title:frankh:add metrics to add insight modal menu

review.posthog_relevance: Adds support for a new dashboard insight modal variant and its associated metadata, including theme support and query type metadata, while also adding a feature flag check for the new insight builder.
review.reason: Adds two snapshot entries for a new modal variant, including dark and light themes, and an import for FEATURE_FLAGS to check if the new insight builder is enabled. Also adds an import for QUERY_TYPES_METADATA and NodeKind to support the new query type metadata and icon. This is a narrow, localized change adding support for a new UI variant and its metadata, without broader systemic
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit and user impact are not demonstrated, and the tier is assigned based on the observed code, not the claimed benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No tier assignment is made; score is withheld. No score is assigned.
